name: suppress_conditional_model_part_variants

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SuppressConditionalModelPartVariants takes no Script context, sets D_002C1EA8 bit 12, and does not access the value stack

notes: func_0012FF78 tests D_002C1EA8 bit 12 while resolving model-part references whose descriptor type is 3 or 4. Setting the bit bypasses the runtime-dependent alternate selection and keeps the default part variant. The 60 JP calls occur in cinematic sequences; 51 have a later command 442 in the same entry to restore conditional selection.
